topics.title: Confirm your Student Pass renewal fee
topics.answer: APU publishes different fees based on renewal length and how far ahead you submit. Open the renewal planner for an estimate and confirm the amount with Immigration Services before paying.
sources: APU renewal instructions and fee table

keywords: where is the student pass office
topics.title: Find Immigration Services
topics.answer: The Immigration Services Counter is on Level 4 of the New Campus. Its published counter hours are 10:00 am to 3:00 pm on weekdays, excluding public holidays. Passport submission has a separate schedule.

topics.title: Plan your Student Pass renewal
topics.answer: Start about three months before your pass expires. APU asks for at least 18 months of passport validity. Use the planner to check the documents, see the published fee tier and open the official submission instructions.

topics.title: Get campus IT support
topics.answer: For walk-in IT help, go to the TechCentre on Level 6, opposite Block D. For Wi-Fi setup, open APU’s on-campus wireless guide. The Virtual Help Centre provides an online support route.

topics.title: See coursework and reminders
topics.answer: Use Coursework to see sample Moodle deadlines or import a calendar file. Compass shows in-app reminders 7, 3 and 1 day before the deadline in Malaysia time. Mark a task complete once you have submitted it in Moodle.

topics.title: See what’s happening on campus
topics.answer: Open Events for the current demo listings. You can filter for events on now or coming up, check the organizer and venue, register in the demo, or add an event to your calendar.

topics.title: Contact the Bursary
topics.answer: The Bursary handles tuition fees, payments and account enquiries. Use the APSpace office directory for its current contact, location and opening hours.

topics.title: Find Academic Admin
topics.answer: Academic Admin is the starting point for student records and programme administration. Check the APSpace directory for current office details.

topics.title: Find the campus library
topics.answer: APU lists its campus library and study facilities in the official campus facilities guide.

topics.title: Check your official Student Pass progress
topics.answer: Use Track Student Pass in APSpace or open EMGS to check your application. The Compass inbox shows the next action from a selected sample email.

topics.title: Find the right campus service
topics.answer: Search the directory by office or the type of help you need. Office cards link to APU sources for current hours, location and contact details.

checklist: Confirm at least 18 months of validity.
Include your details page, current pass and most recent Malaysian entry stamp. Check the source for any additional pages.
Confirm any extra requirements with Immigration Services.
Check APU’s official fee table before paying.
Keep the transaction receipt with your renewal documents.
Follow the university’s instructions to send the required documents and receipt.
